programme.title: 紮根 #2
programme.desc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計

programme.title: 巨象同盟:長牙兄弟情
programme.desc: 沉浸於「長牙雄象」錯綜複雜的生活世界,認識三頭處於不同生命階段的非洲雄象:克雷格,帕斯卡與以掃深入一窺全球最大陸生哺乳類那細緻微妙的交流語言,複雜的社群互動,以及彼此之間深厚而緊密的情感連結

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #1
programme.desc: 亞馬遜熱帶雨林中,擁有致命力量的掠食者正在捕獵完美的進化 - 誰將獲得勝利?

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #2
programme.desc: 如同亞馬遜的森林一樣豐富,尋找愛情和養家一樣是個挑戰,交配策略也跟動物一樣各適其適

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #3
programme.desc: 樹木主導亞馬遜地區,總數目超過三千億但是它們每一個都是獨立又蓬勃發展的生態系統它們是數十種不同動物所組成的繁忙社區

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #4
programme.desc: 在亞馬遜森林中,情況可以瞬間從破裂的土地變為氾濫或被樹木淹沒認識活在這個古老世界的物種必須如何足智多謀和有上進心,才能生存

programme.title: 顛沛流離亞馬遜 #5
programme.desc: 每年有20萬隻秘魯猴子被非法販運,大部分更是嬰兒猴子島為販賣,合法和非法狩獵的受害者提供第二次機會我們記錄了這些年輕猴子的生存困境

programme.title: 動物王國 #6
programme.desc: 壯觀,刺激和累人的海陸空之旅是許多物種生活中的關鍵這些王國為尋找食物,棲息地或伴侶而踏上旅途但當這些計劃涉及數百甚至數千個體時,預訂和組織旅程就變得不容易了

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #1
programme.desc: 非洲的潮間帶是獨特動植物的家園那裡的生命已經適應在充滿挑戰的海洋環境中生存,一些物種能夠活在裸露的岩石上,而其他則寧願留在岩池的庇護下

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #2
programme.desc: 在非洲的東海岸,溫暖的厄加勒斯角以獨特的亞熱帶景觀向南延伸從紅樹林沼澤到色彩斑斕的珊瑚礁所構成的區域,當中有在長而暖的沙灘上繁殖的海龜,以及最近才發現的「活化石」- 腔棘魚,牠棲息在深海底的峽谷中

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #3
programme.desc: 這是「黃金森林」的故事,坐落在非洲西南海岸的大片海帶由大西洋深處的營養物質所養育,滋潤著四個不同的世界

programme.title: 「非」一般海岸 #4
programme.desc: 位處非洲南部海岸的阿爾哥亞灣,是該大陸唯一的企鵝避難所跟企鵝一起求生,牠們勇於接受難以容忍的因素,以建立一個不可能的海洋社區

programme.title: 獮猴島 #1 英普
programme.desc: 穿梭於綠意盎然的城市,獮猴族長馬特諾爾以鐵腕手段,一直統治擁有30名成員的街頭部族另一邊廂,老領袖阿拉夫則管理更具野性的深山部族年少氣盛的洛基該挑戰哪一位的王者寶座?

programme.title: 獮猴島 #2 英普
programme.desc: 跟隨街頭部族穿梭大街小巷,享受一次充滿垃圾食物的城市假期鏡頭一轉,看看深山部族趁機入侵街頭部族的領地後,情勢如何急轉直下目擊姐妹團如何組織綁架莎拉寶寶的陰謀,而新上任的領袖洛基則發現他的老對手已經重返城鎮

programme.title: 獮猴島 #3 英普

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #2 英普

programme.title: 動物格鬥士 #3 英普

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與丹一同踏上旅程,穿越嚴酷無情的蒙古荒野,只為尋找那隻史上有紀錄以來體型最大的雪豹:「老兄」(The Dude)目睹他如何在充滿敵意,危機四伏的地形與環境中奮力前行,並在未知與不確定中披荊斬棘,同時揭示「老兄」以及其他雪豹在生存上所面臨的艱難挑戰與嚴峻現實

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探,追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵,更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 動物知心友 #3
programme.desc: 窺探塔斯馬尼亞惡魔的溫柔一面,與一隻具冒險精神的海龜相遇,並與小鹿一起享受家庭聚餐與800公斤的公牛斯普德踢足球,了解貓頭鷹迪格在保育者尼格爾的癌症治療期間,如何為他帶來安慰

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​來認識「濱水」獅群的成員吧:雄獅湯姆・湯姆與卡勒,八隻雌獅,十頭年輕的獅子,以及愛因斯坦,那頭從未離開家園,如今已長成的幼獅當愛因斯坦的反叛之舉逐漸發酵,最終在「外來者」獅群的對手發動攻勢時,為他釘下了命運的定局

programme.title: 獅群的法則 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​感受炙熱高溫,當獅群努力狩獵足夠食物,乾旱條件逼迫他們與獵物一同陷入接近死亡的險境,生命幾乎被推向邊緣觀看愛因斯坦適應孤獨生活,然後評估戰場殘局,在新手母親卡爾維茲為幼崽性命而奮戰之後

programme.title: 海灘「龜」來記
programme.desc: 當成千上萬的海龜日以繼夜登上哥斯達黎加的海灘生下數以百萬計的蛋,當地人稱之為「到達」本節目滿是新發現,加拿大自然學家及攝影師胡戈基奇跟隨一隊國際科學家團隊進行創新性的科學考察,以解開這個稀有現象的謎底

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #1
programme.desc: 南非的野生海岸綿延170英里印度和大西洋的海流匯合於此,逼使大浪湧向海岸線這裡也是駐莫桑比克的鬼蝠魟研究員安德里亞馬歇爾希望���南非境內進行首次鬼蝠魟探索的地方

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #2
programme.desc: 莫桑比克的野生海岸線綿延1600多英里 - 當中充滿了各種海洋生物一些世上最大的濾食器被這處營養豐富的水域所吸引但即使這些大型生物也無法抵禦魯莽的過度捕撈莫桑比克兩位領先的海洋研究人員安德里亞馬歇爾和娜奇亞古蘭開始尋找海洋中最隱秘的動物之一,並保護其中最知名的動物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #3
programme.desc: 莫桑比克海岸以其巨人而聞名:從每年冬季到訪的座頭鯨到常駐該處的鯨鯊但仔細觀察就可以發現一個很少被探索的微小物種的神秘世界雖然經常被忽視,牠們對所居住的生態系統同樣重要在這個野生和無法預測的海岸,海洋科學家們不惜一切地保護著莫桑比克最小的生物,免得為時已晚

programme.title: 野性汪洋 #4
programme.desc: 海洋佔據地球的70%,是多達一百萬種已知動植物的家園但鞏固全球最大食物網的卻是最小的海洋生物 - 浮游生物這些微生物漂流在海洋的眾多棲息地,所到之處就會觸發覓食週期沒有牠們,海洋中的生命將不復存在

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #5
programme.desc: Ben 搭船前往阿卡羅瓦的一座鮭魚養殖場,了解紐西蘭帝王鮭與大西洋鮭的不同之處他親自捕撈鮭魚,並在俯瞰港灣的海岸邊烹調他也介紹了一款高品質的本地食用油,兼具健康與多功能性,體現對本地農業與永續的承諾

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #6
programme.desc: 正值核果盛產季節!Ben 造訪中奧塔哥一個由家族經營的果園,該果園以核果產季長,與土地及社區的緊密連結而聞名他發現了一座全電力運作的櫻桃農場,將優質外銷櫻桃直接販售給紐西蘭民眾

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #7
programme.desc: Ben 體驗魯阿佩胡地區正崛起的飲食文化,以及悠久的市集園藝歷史他拜訪了一位第六代農夫,該農夫將一片偏遠荒野打造成繁榮的生態旅遊與高級餐飲目的地,並與一位屢獲殊榮的主廚合作

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 4 #1
programme.desc: Ben 的美食之旅從南島西岸展開他在霍基蒂卡(Hokitika)的一座農場遇見了全紐西蘭唯一的蔓越莓生產者,接著前往布萊克波爾(Blackball)學習臘腸(chorizo)的製作過程Ben 隨後在海灘上烹調出多道結合這些在地美味的料理,並搭配當地啤酒享用

programme.title: 艾倫康明最奢華的火車之旅:蘇格蘭 #1

programme.title: Cute Pet Guide
programme.desc: The meerkat king from "Madagascar" is funny, but meerkats in real life are well-behaved, cuddly and they heal our hearts! Pocket sized pets are currently all the rage, but there are details you need to pay attention to when raising them For example, hedgehogs are highly defensive, timid sugar gliders will harm themselves without being next to their owners, and cute guinea pigs like Norman from the movie "The Secret Life of Pets" are easily abandoned due to being easy to obtain and raise, etc Don't worry, experts will teach you how to raise them! Come to a restaurant in Kaohsiung to get up close with Rocket Raccoon from “The Avengers”!

programme.title: Zoo Vet At Large
programme.desc: Dr Matt gets to play nanny to a very tiny but very vocal abandoned baby badger, and meets Vicky, the lovesick cockatoo who's fallen in love with her owner, in the seventh of the series Up at the zoo Matt fills in the cracks in a tortoise's shell and then meets the latest additions to the aquarium 20 baby seahorses, much to the delight of keeper Jackie High on the North York Moors an unruly alpaca faces castration, while back at the surgery Matt renews an old acquaintance - Archie the iguana is back, this time to have part of his tail removed

programme.title: Cute Pets At Home
programme.desc: The Japanese animated film My Neighbor Totoro, which is popular all over the world is the childhood memory of many Totoro's classic furry body, round eyes and cute expression are very endearing In South America, there is a kind of chinchilla that looks very similar to Totoro in the film I heard that Taiwan now allows legal imports of these animals for breeding! Today, let’s follow the Totoro zoo owner Molly and fall in love with the soft and cute charm of this animation star!

programme.title: Snake Master
programme.desc: Renowned herpetologist Nirut Chomngam takes viewers on a wild journey across the country in an unforgettable adventure filled with deadly encounters, as he joins conservation teams tasked with protecting these astonishing creatures and their jungle home

programme.title: Survive The Wild
programme.desc: From armored bodies, to feisty attitudes, to outright deception… there is only one rule to defense: do whatever it takes to survive the wild

programme.title: World of the Wild E6
programme.desc: Home to an extraordinary biodiversity, the jungles of Asia are among the most ancient rainforests on Earth – they are also among the planet’s most rapidly disappearing habitats

programme.title: Super Senses
programme.desc: There’s a whole world and more than one spectrum of sensations that animals are aware of, yet which just pass humans by And yet, while it’s widely known that, for example, a dog’s sense of smell is dozens of times more acute than humans’, or that goats have close on a 360 degree field of vision, there’s a kind of “sixth sense” that some animals have which still defies explanation Call it extra-sensory perception – animal abilities we can’t entirely explain but which leave us wondering - and in awe

programme.title: The Blue Realm
programme.desc: “Tentacles” follows Dr Jennifer Mather as she leads a team of renowned scientists to the beautiful Caribbean Island of Bonaire Their mission is to prove a controversial theory: reef squid speak to each other with a complex language they paint on their skin

programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天5 我為上帝精彩過
programme.desc: 在人生旅途中走歪路、下錯車,弄得滿身傷痕、萬劫不復,惟有祂並不介意我們的過去,願意領我們走向美好的將來。《如果還有明天5我為上帝精彩過》,深入中國廣西山區孤兒院,記錄殘障青年在信仰中找回尊嚴和盼望的故事。攝製隊再遠赴南半球,見證澳洲天生失明女歌手及輪椅上的媽媽,突破身體局限活出主愛無限;還有美國摘冠

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 本地臘腸零舍不同，製作工序原來極其講究，可謂「臘腸煲湯－ 估佢唔到」！工場老闆揭開臘腸的美味秘密。中國人重視結婚紀念日，當中紙婚、皮婚有何所指？「拉埋天窗」又有甚麼寓意？昔日銅鑼灣確曾出現「銅鑼」，卻於五十年代銷聲匿跡，到底怎麼回事？送禮欠心思，隨時被視為「張飛食豆芽－ 小菜一碟」。主持們學做字母朱古力，向至愛傳遞甜蜜心意。「未見官先打三十大板」果真有法可依，且聽中文講師廖舜禧解讀相關大清刑法。

programme.title: 粵講粵㜺鬼粵
programme.desc: 東山少爺（許文軒）「沙塵白霍」，卻鍾情「女子無才便是德」的西關小姐（戴祖儀），旁有下人（鄧智堅）、妹仔（麥美恩）、管家（大學講師廖舜禧）插科打諢，這齣在廣州上演的趣劇有多㜺鬼？「生螆貓入眼」形容女子芳心暗許？遇上心儀對象「起痰」亦有根據！智堅扮演的「火水哥」要出招討好「女神」江嘉敏，順道讓大家了解上述戀愛徵狀。首集還有掌故專家鄭寶鴻細談石塘咀「塘西風月」，及蕭欣浩博士講解「打小人」習俗的口訣妙語。

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 素食者鄧麗欣為避免品嚐西班牙火腿美食，不希望勝出比賽，對手林曉峰為求一睹她吃肉的畫面，亦想落敗，二人卻苦了想享用美食的農夫！秘魯人能為一杯雞尾酒去到幾盡？台北以口拉芝士雞排不斷的紀錄，長度有多驚人？

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵
programme.desc: 東京一杯綠茶啤酒出現的理由、清邁一碗大麵的罵人名字、首爾餐廳食客不停搖動盒子的原因，三個問題的答案都簡單淺顯，梁烈唯及江欣燕卻猜不到。Do姐以簡單方法分勝負，勝出者可享用日本飛驒牛，卻大呼贏得不光彩？

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 科學一眼看清粵英
programme.desc: 《科學一眼看清》旨在讓每個人都能接觸到科學！透過簡單的實驗、有趣的軼事和壯觀的視覺效果，回到過去，了解最偉大科學家的生活，了解他們的發明如何改變我們的世界。

programme.title: 星夢頻道粵日
programme.desc: 為了紀念玫露熊在星夢公主杯變成偶像吉祥物，Meltic StAr決定舉辦一場盛大派對，但大家愈是熱情，玫露熊反而愈為不安，更在派對當天逃離會場。但玫露熊之所以不敢露面，除了不安，似乎還有其他原因……

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險粵普
programme.desc: 未來的小羊們獲得了灰太狼新制的發明“變小手錶”，變成迷你版小羊並坐上慢羊羊發明的玩具小車，前往微觀世界，幫助大家解決各式各樣的問題。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 胖虎上課偷看漫畫被老師沒收，然後勒令大雄替他取回漫畫，多啦A夢於是借他「一二三紅綠燈帽」。因為不願替媽媽出去買信封，多啦A夢拿出「外賣電話」，用這法寶能外賣包括人在內的任何東西。

programme.title: 少女煮意日常粵日
programme.desc: 明天就是飲食文化研究會的集訓，在詩音帶領下，大家遠離繁囂，到處觀光。可是當來到營地木屋，外面卻突然下起大雨，惟有改變計劃，在室內享受玩樂。入睡前，大家談起昔日回憶，真子卻發現九禮亞有點悶悶不樂。

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 豪華郵輪嚴格遵守防疫措施下，重新啟航！余思霆從基隆港登船，品嚐禁止自助的自助餐，體驗船上夜生活。翌早，思霆「叉足電」，換上泳衣大歎海上日光浴。隨着郵輪抵達高雄港，思霆把握郵輪停泊一天的時間，感受南台灣的熱情！駁二藝術特區從百年老倉庫搖身一變，成為文青新蒲點。除了行逛文創小店、欣賞藝術裝置之外，純白色的旋轉木馬、摩天輪更是網紅打卡點！愛河是休閒觀光好去處，愛玩水上活動的思霆，划着直立板獨享河岸美景。

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 經典煲仔菜可怎樣注入創新滋味，打動嘉賓龔嘉欣、常駐評判黃永幟、余健志？對陣前，保哥帶煮將阿昌覓食啟發靈感，Ricky隊的Alan則有專業團隊支援，同樣信心十足。阿昌以手製蝦膠、老虎蝦乾釀入滑雞，奉上「子母蝦滑雞煲仔飯」，但何以將米量減半？時間尚餘十分鐘，他還未煲飯，卻保持一貫淡定？「當火焰紅蝦遇上冰鎮千絲」，顛覆大家對煲仔飯的認知。Alan用西班牙紅蝦熬湯煮飯，配上蜜瓜、苦瓜等冷絲，締造冰火口感！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 二百蚊預算，怎樣煮出精緻頭盤、主菜與甜品？菲菲主打不時不食，「海鮮雜炊」集海中蝦、花蛤等鮮味精華，配以茭白筍兩吃作首尾呼應。Ricky再三提醒菲菲要認真試味，為何卻甚勞氣？Carlina巧手呈現「五味人生」，還用苦瓜做��品？她為馬頭魚起肉時用錯方法，令眾人好緊張，話口未完果然出事……「隊長幫手」時間寶貴，她請保哥隔渣，認真大材小用！經過黎諾懿等評判品評後，勝出隊員雖可晉級，卻深深自責不在狀態……

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: MEN’S COOK菜式是煎牛扒，並以氣炸鍋弄伴菜，兩位祥哥亦忍不住大爆入行以來最令人氣炸的經歷！MEN’S TALK環節選了男人史上最難抉擇的二選一，就是兄弟與女友該選哪一邊？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 黃心穎能夠獲得網民賦予「BB」稱號，可見「人氣」絕對非同小可。「心穎BB」憑著甜美外貌，贏得廣大少男歡心，由她親手炮製的甜品又是否份外甜美可口？古嘉俊(阿古)這次便要透過特色甜品，激發「心穎BB」的醉人魅力，皆因他用上紅酒炮製「紅酒黃梅蘋果撻」，藉著醇酒濃郁芳香，帶出蘋果另類風味。心穎自言享受製作甜品過程，原來與一種男生最愛嗜好有關，且聽她本人親自講解。

programme.title: 新幹線戰士 改變世界粵日
programme.desc: 太晴等人連同大和與九十九一起進入元宇宙接受訓練，完事後卻無法登出，情況酷似零時當年發生意外之時。眾人面前出現零時的影像，赫然是當年意外的後續發展。伊奈拆解入侵程式，懷疑是雛子所為。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「My Little Show」舞台迎來五位女生，她們合拍又優雅地表演芭蕾舞，舞姿輕盈動人。五人平日還會擔任小老師，指導師妹練習，可見她們對跳舞的熱愛。接着，一位男孩獨自登場，彈奏出悠揚琴音，展示平日努力練習的成果。為了歌頌「正確的人生態度」，結他導師彈奏<非凡、<常言道，和Sherman姐姐、Emily姐姐一同合唱，歌聲充滿正能量。此外，結他導師還分享了「音樂之父」巴哈的一段「瘋狂」軼事。

programme.title: 屁屁偵探粵日
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 老師要同學們寫新一年的目標。小丸子因為經常賴床而導致遲到，因此就寫了希望來年糾正賴床的習慣。其後，小丸子得知原來其他同學都是依靠鬧鐘起床，於是決定用自己的儲蓄去買鬧鐘。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視粵
programme.desc: 近年匹克球成為時興運動，打球的場所亦越開越多，部分更是走高級路線開在甲級商廈內。這個來自美國，有超過半世紀歷史的國際動漫展，今年首次在香港舉行，情況有多熱鬧？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
星期日檔案粵
programme.desc: 根據大學聯招就業資料庫數據，2025年提供予畢業生的，全職工作機會從2023年的87萬個，暴跌至2025年的307萬個，跌幅近六成五。大學生找工作難，少數族裔求職者挑戰更大。因為中文程度、文化宗教等因素，少數族裔求職者面對重重挑戰。但在「一帶一路」倡議、發展清真市場背景下，這些少數族裔又有何獨特優勢呢？

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 III粵
programme.desc: 「警聲百二秒」系列再次歸來，《警聲百二秒 III》由警方代表聯同眾多藝員參與演出，會繼續透過有趣的故事情節，介紹香港警務處更多部門的工作、更多防罪訊息，讓廣大市民可輕鬆「全方位」了解警隊更多資訊。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 關於日前男子於巴士上非禮女學生的案件，節目接獲觀眾報料，指涉事男子疑為慣犯。事主委託裝修公司進行全屋翻新工程，但在工程展開後，卻發現施工質量不符預期，而且訂製的傢具亦出現貨不對辦情況。事主要求終止合約遭拒，並聲稱受到恐嚇，遂向多家媒體求助，並向政府相關部門提出投訴。市民在港鐵中環站乘搭扶手電梯時發生意外，電梯突然停止運作，導致事主跌倒並滾下扶手電梯受傷，傷勢頗為嚴重。

programme.title: 保濟丸130 週年呈獻：中年好聲音4粵
programme.desc: <會過去的前奏響起，車婉婉率先開口演繹，好拍檔許志安隨後驚喜登場接唱，錄影廠即時傳出熱烈掌聲，海兒更開心得猶如小迷妹，亮着手機燈光應援。一連兩集，十四強選手將以許志安的歌曲作比拼，安仔亦會擔任「嘉賓評審」，一同評核各人表現。他還「化身」點唱機，從這輪歌單隨意揀歌，選擇相應歌曲的參賽者就會亮相演唱。每集最低分的三位選手將走進「待定區」，最終會有一人被淘汰。此外，本集有查小欣、馬天佑出任「知音人」。

programme.title: 衍生七星茶呈獻：一周星星粵
programme.desc: 張衛健、劉青雲、容祖兒為玩具主題動畫系列再配音，三人聚首受訪卻是首次？先「考古」重溫健仔、青雲合演的處境劇片段，原來已是三十多年前！再回放祖兒跟偶像青雲合作拍電影時的訪問，青雲頓感尷尬及面紅。動畫片中講述一眾玩具漸被電子產品取代，三人現實中又偏好傳統還是電子化？健仔笑稱愛寫字同時會發揮藝術家天分！「你問我答」環節，祖兒被小學同學王祖藍問起喜歡的男生條件，另邊廂有人斗膽問健仔的頭髮何時開始慢慢消失？

programme.title: 美食新聞周報粵
programme.desc: 飲食專家劉惠平品嚐根據《食經》炮製的佳餚，包括酒糟蒸馬友、江南百花雞，並細說相關「嚐識」。荃灣地膽Ryan帶暉哥上山「飲茶」，紙包骨、招牌沙翁、山水豆腐花皆是必吃之選。暉哥再隨陳國強師傅前往新加坡「搵食」，造訪海鮮街「人氣」餐廳，試吃招牌「飛天」龍蝦伊麵、黑胡椒炒辣蟹，充滿驚喜！行仔、施焯日走訪西營盤多間老店，試吃薄荷朱古力味蛋卷及三角蛋糕，黃糖及椰汁砵仔糕，以及蓮蓉棋子餅等，別具風味。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
廉政狙擊#5粵PG
programme.desc: 名流雲集的展覽會上，卓廷光與屠敏首次碰面。曉山潛入酒店，拍下Ray Chin與富豪私下交易的罪證，險被發現之際，幸得子峰及時解救。傅天耀的手下Jackie暗中買兇殺以凡，致其身受重傷，幸得屠敏救助才保住性命。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 關於日前男子於巴士上非禮女學生的案件，節目接獲觀眾報料，指涉事男子疑為慣犯。事主委託裝修公司進行全屋翻新工程，但在工程展開後，卻發現施工質量不符預期，而且訂製的傢具亦出現貨不對辦情況。事主要求終止合約遭拒，並聲稱受到恐嚇，遂向多家媒體求助，並向政府相關部門提出投訴。市民在港鐵中環站乘搭扶手電梯時發生意外，電梯突然停止運作，導致事主跌倒並滾下扶手電梯受傷，傷勢頗為嚴重。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季粵普
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 非洲潮什麼粵
programme.desc: 與肯亞馬塞馬拉的野生動物打過招呼，當然亦要探訪當地人。芷珮早就提出申請，由導遊帶領參觀馬塞的遊牧民族住處，認識到牧民的快樂根源原來很簡單，令芷珮大為感觸。為讓觀眾感受更多，芷珮特意預訂不同的營地入住，並從中探索原林文化。為何當地男人自小已學原地跳躍比高？每名男子皆腰纏一把刀，又有何用途？變幻無常，芷珮想在平原上看一次日落，卻因天氣破壞而錯過。回顧整個《非洲潮什麼》旅程，她有什麼感受與得着？

programme.title: 甜心先生粵
programme.desc: 黃心穎能夠獲得網民賦予「BB」稱號，可見「人氣」絕對非同小可。「心穎BB」憑著甜美外貌，贏得廣大少男歡心，由她親手炮製的甜品又是否份外甜美可口？古嘉俊(阿古)這次便要透過特色甜品，激發「心穎BB」的醉人魅力，皆因他用上紅酒炮製「紅酒黃梅蘋果撻」，藉著醇酒濃郁芳香，帶出蘋果另類風味。心穎自言享受製作甜品過程，原來與一種男生最愛嗜好有關，且聽她本人親自講解。

programme.title: 到此一遊粵
programme.desc: 豪華郵輪嚴格遵守防疫措施下，重新啟航！余思霆從基隆港登船，品嚐禁止自助的自助餐，體驗船上夜生活。翌早，思霆「叉足電」，換上泳衣大歎海上日光浴。隨着郵輪抵達高雄港，思霆把握郵輪停泊一天的時間，感受南台灣的熱情！駁二藝術特區從百年老倉庫搖身一變，成為文青新蒲點。除了行逛文創小店、欣賞藝術裝置之外，純白色的旋轉木馬、摩天輪更是網紅打卡點！愛河是休閒觀光好去處，愛玩水上活動的思霆，划着直立板獨享河岸美景。

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 經典煲仔菜可怎樣注入創新滋味，打動嘉賓龔嘉欣、常駐評判黃永幟、余健志？對陣前，保哥帶煮將阿昌覓食啟發靈感，Ricky隊的Alan則有專業團隊支援，同樣信心十足。阿昌以手製蝦膠、老虎蝦乾釀入滑雞，奉上「子母蝦滑雞煲仔飯」，但何以將米量減半？時間尚餘十分鐘，他還未煲飯，卻保持一貫淡定？「當火焰紅蝦遇上冰鎮千絲」，顛覆大家對煲仔飯的認知。Alan用西班牙紅蝦熬湯煮飯，配上蜜瓜、苦瓜等冷絲，締造冰火口感！

programme.title: 煮戰粵
programme.desc: 二百蚊預算，怎樣煮出精緻頭盤、主菜與甜品？菲菲主打不時不食，「海鮮雜炊」集海中蝦、花蛤等鮮味精華，配以茭白筍兩吃作首尾呼應。Ricky再三提醒菲菲要認真試味，為何卻甚勞氣？Carlina巧手呈現「五味人生」，還用苦瓜做甜品？她為馬頭魚起肉時用錯方法，令眾人好緊張，話口未完果然出事……「隊長幫手」時間寶貴，她請保哥隔渣，認真大材小用！經過黎諾懿等評判品評後，勝出隊員雖可晉級，卻深深自責不在狀態……

programme.desc: 慶與喜不停離開香港，又留書失蹤。高家眾人終發起「尋親團」，舉家到中山欲查明究竟。亨得悉此事後，主動協助高家眾人，更說將安排豪華房車接送，大屋別墅任住。當眾人到達中山後，卻有滿籮不幸的事件正在等候他們。

programme.title: 夢華錄#20粵普
programme.desc: 三娘為被學生欺負的杜長風解圍，杜長風感激不已。千帆終於醒來，並意識到自己只是齊牧的棋子，對齊牧心灰意冷。引章聽到三娘說千帆和盼兒快要成親，才知道只有自己被蒙在鼓裡，毅然跑去找沈如啄，向他示好。

programme.title: 交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌粵
食平D粵
programme.desc: 醬料可令味道昇華。原來想要南乳煮得好，下鍋前有個步驟必定要做。想不到肥媽只需6元便可煮出蝦醬啫啫生菜煲，而且只要兩個步驟，既便宜又快捷。「大廚平煮」有名廚指點，在家亦能煮出貴價的意式雲吞。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 充足的睡眠十分重要，但如何才算「充足」？都市人常見的失眠成因甚多，部份因素更會互相影響！「睡眠衛生」是指一系列幫助提升睡眠質量的方法，又有甚麼壞習慣要避免？Louis Yan甄澤權將舉行首個紅館個人魔術演出，他到來預告一些特別表演環節，當中會挑戰世界十大危險魔術之一？他曾登上不同的魔術舞台，卻難忘一次準備前赴拉斯維加斯表演的經歷，究竟發生何事？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓示範「太陽肉餅」，維他命D夠豐富！

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 比賽之前，有素人參賽者竟說不出主持森美的名字，他可會記恨在心？陸浩明牽手女友陳詩欣，還有蘇麗珊、羅雪妍這對「整餅姊妹」，同來參加這場家事常識比拼。選擇題回合，麗珊、雪妍竟要靠猜拳決定答案？有題目問到在使用過程中容易結霜的雪櫃款式，某參賽者家中有七個雪櫃，當然深諳相關知識，輕鬆答對。動作題看過教學片段，其中三組參賽者要鬥快把紙箱製成凳子。主持倪嘉雯擔任「測試專員」，怎料樂極生悲，究竟發生甚麼事？

programme.title: 街坊財爺#21粵PG
programme.desc: 當日蔣嬌出千被追捕，獲行健所救。行健將蔣嬌重新改造，讓她獲得露絲的信任，並合作謀奪金仔家財。金仔、露絲結婚周年紀念，金仔買公仔送給露絲。蔣嬌暗中把槍藏在公仔內，打算陷害金仔。警方接報搜查戴家，發現槍匣。露絲在車內發現公仔及手槍，此時被警方截查。楊桃指露絲手上的槍是宇森失槍，而且曾經槍擊行健家外，露絲被拘留。俊軒懷疑金仔對付行健，連累露絲，父子當眾衝突。宇森因與瑪莉的關係，被警方懷疑，宇森憤然辭職。

programme.desc: 什麼動物腿最多？什麼動物最愛乾淨？什麼動物最長壽？想知道這些動物界神奇的世界紀錄嗎？快和皮皮龍一起走進奇妙的動物世界吧！探索動物新紀錄，神奇發現全記住！

programme.title: 奇妙的動物之動物新紀錄粵普

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 升學面試令不少家長與學童都感到煩惱，「Kids’ Notes」請來教育機構創辦人，為大家講述升中面試要點，並帶來小貼士。AI成大趨勢，升中面試亦不免會涉獵到AI方向。專家提醒切忌背誦標準答案，建議引用「STAR原則」思考，藉情境、任務、行動、結果來展示學童的邏輯性，詳情如何？學童亦可試試採用幽默的方式融合答案，並於自我介紹中加入數字、名人、新聞等元素，給予面試官一個深刻的印象；還有甚麼「加分位」？

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 踩滑板熱潮興起，但大雄怕痛不願嘗試，多啦A夢於是帶他和其他人去到重力較低嘅月球。天冷下雪，大雄不願意出外活動，卻又想享受運動後的疲勞，便託多啦A夢用運動膏貼去收集疲勞並移轉到他身上。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.desc: 沙田市中心一帶，交投活躍，帶動樓價反彈，區內細單位要多少錢，是否適合收租？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2824粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 力蓮要兼顧市場部，工作繁重，瑞輝建議找可信任之人代勞，她遂將若水空降為市場部暫代主管。若水立即接手大量工作，苦不堪言。其實力蓮另有盤算，龔燁識破其意圖，故意讓力蓮發現他與若水頻頻爭吵，並表明他不會助若水處理市場部的工作，試圖令力蓮知難而退，不再難為若水，怎料卻適得其反。力蓮設法「懲罰」若水，龔燁後來得知若水要應付一位好色客人，擔心她出事，遂前往察看，詎料……

programme.title: 鼎植口腔呈獻：香港探秘地圖#16粵PG
programme.desc: 探秘地圖的問米影片，成功引起金夫人對頻道的關注。文彬察覺畢萍對他有所迴避，故與一臣夾計，上演一齣放棄愛慕畢萍的戲碼，畢萍信以為真。秀儀探訪巫姑單位後，噩夢頻生，一臣建議秀儀再找巫姑尋求答案。畢鳴陪秀儀找巫姑，巫姑問米竟招來秀儀的母親上身與秀儀對話，秀儀回憶起兒時零碎往事。畢鳴意外見到秀儀腋下真有Rocky提及的疤痕，遂與文彬計劃測試秀儀。畢萍撞見，制止二人。畢萍直覺秀儀出現古怪情況，與一臣有關……

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：成何體統#21粵普
programme.desc: 夏侯澹留信告知晚音他穿越的實情，晚音按信中安排趕往沛陽。官兵一路追捕，危急關頭，曾受晚音救助的啞女小賊帶她躲藏。端王逼夏侯澹寫遺詔由其攝政，卻反被嘲笑其懦弱。晚音為感激啞女帶路往沛陽為她起名花花。

programme.title: K Cash找數王呈獻：夫妻肺片粵PG
programme.desc: 育有小朋友後，周志康自覺已不被太太重視？陳展鵬反指另一半於婚後多了來電！對於生B後欠缺獨處時間，兩嘉賓似乎都接受得來。照料子女是偏重於女性的職責，若遇上豬隊友，主持吳若希寧願對方「撓埋雙手」！雨僑覺得丈夫羅力威拍拖時夠細心，到湊小朋友卻是另一回事！賴慰玲則稱讚丈夫是神隊友。會照顧小孩的還有「四大長老」，輔導心理學家道出男士要記下三個重點，以應對婆媳糾紛。父母於原家庭的出生次序亦影響管教子女方針？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

無名天使3D#14粵PG
programme.desc: 麗花等接待拉美耶，其保鑣李天華態度囂張，令麗花甚為不滿。小嫻告訴樂琦，少峰要求離婚，樂琦大吃一驚。少峰表明會為樂琦離婚，樂琦即時拒絕了他。少峰苦苦相逼，樂琦時碰上堅強，遂找堅強幫忙，堅強認出樂琦是當日救他的警花，傾慕不已。堅強發現樂琦不慎遺下口紅，誤會樂琦對他有意。少峰苦等樂琦，樂琦拒而不見，時堅強送回口紅，樂琦借他解圍，故意和他親熱，堅強以為飛來艷福。寶兒和一鳴拍拖，甜蜜非常，寶兒決定把拍拖一事保密。拉美耶遇襲，天華和麗花合力營救，化解危機，二人行動合拍，終化敵為友。

programme.desc: 比賽之前，有素人參賽者竟說不出主持森美的名字，他可會記恨在心？陸浩明牽手女友陳詩欣，還有蘇麗珊、羅雪妍這對「整餅姊妹」，同來參加這場家事常識比拼。選擇題回合，麗珊、雪妍竟要靠猜拳決定答案？有題目問到在使用過程中容易結霜的雪櫃款式，某參賽者家中有七個雪櫃，當然深諳相關知識，輕鬆答對。動作題看過教學片段，其中三組參賽者要鬥快把紙箱製成凳子。主持倪嘉雯擔任「測試專員」，怎料樂極生悲，究竟發生甚麼事？

programme.title: 街坊財爺#21粵PG
programme.desc: 當日蔣嬌出千被追捕，獲行健所救。行健將蔣嬌重新改造，讓她獲得露絲的信任，並合作謀奪金仔家財。金仔、露絲結婚周年紀念，金仔買公仔送給露絲。蔣嬌暗中把槍藏在公仔內，打算陷害金仔。警方接報搜查戴家，發現槍匣。露絲在車內發現公仔及手槍，此時被警方截查。楊桃指露絲手上的槍是宇森失槍，而且曾經槍擊行健家外，露絲被拘留。俊軒懷疑金仔對付行健，連累露絲，父子當眾衝突。宇森因與瑪莉的關係，被警方懷疑，宇森憤然辭職。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#114粵
programme.desc: 慶與喜不停離開香港，又留書失蹤。高家眾人終發起「尋親團」，舉家到中山欲查明究竟。亨得悉此事後，主動協助高家眾人，更說將安排豪華房車接送，大屋別墅任住。當眾人到達中山後，卻有滿籮不幸的事件正在等候他們。

programme.title: 夢華錄#20粵普
programme.desc: 三娘為被學生欺負的杜長風解圍，杜長風感激不已。千帆終於醒來，並意識到自己只是齊牧的棋子，對齊牧心灰意冷。引章聽到三娘說千帆和盼兒快要成親，才知道只有自己被蒙在鼓裡，毅然跑去找沈如啄，向他示好。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
高朋滿座#115粵
programme.desc: 原來慶這段日子頻頻失蹤，目的是尋找失散的弟弟、家族隱藏的族譜及寶藏。眾人為避免秘密洩漏，竟狠心將亨排除在外。對於突然被疏離，亨憤憤不平。另一方面，眾人努力搜查後，發現寶藏竟埋藏於亨所新購入的別墅當中。

programme.title: 夢華錄#21粵普
programme.desc: 歐陽旭當清客，被路經西京的柯政訓斥，柯政不接受其辯解，還將他過往所贈之物全部歸還。千帆查閱盼兒父親案的卷宗，令他不知如何面對盼兒，連盼兒需要錢開酒樓也讓陳廉跑腿，恰巧他又被安排接洽北使，更是分身不暇。

programme.title: 食平D粵
programme.desc: 三文魚含豐富的奧米加3，肥媽用44元便煮出三文魚三吃，而且只需兩個步驟便煮出名貴日菜鹽燒三文魚頭，魚頭香脆可口，連骨頭亦可食用。除了用胡椒去除三文魚的腥味外，肥媽還另有秘訣。「大廚平煮」有鴛鴦蝦多士。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿自參加無綫電視第18期藝員訓練班入行，轉瞬已二十五載。他近年多棲發展，既是演員、監製，又身兼飲食集團創意總監，更是兩子之父，認為哪個身分最具挑戰？諾懿亮相節目，分享育兒心得，以及多年的演藝得着。「跟大廚去搵食」，許美德師傅接力登場，引領大王、菲比品味上海名菜，「蔥燒海參」、「干燒明蝦球」、「樟茶大鴨」等大菜悉數上桌，展現上海菜的精緻技藝。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐示範「豆醬蒜苗薑爆雞」。

programme.title: HOME即是識粵
programme.desc: 接着的動作題是要令木板上的劃痕變淡，「孖妹」與兩隊猛男對壘，某隊更因大力擦木板而打翻物品，認真激烈。來到從雪櫃找答案，究竟甚麼物品能去除衣物上的油性筆跡？兩隊均鎖定「熟米飯」作目標，可會是正確答案？踏入搶答題回合，經過三條問題，某藝人隊暫時領先，令人大跌眼鏡。「朱古力」是裝修術語，但裝修老闆、油漆工人都不知為何物！有隊伍於尾聲連續答對兩題追至與對手同分，要以決勝題分高低，能否延續後上氣勢一舉晉級？

programme.title: 街坊財爺#22粵PG
programme.desc: 金仔為救露絲想盡方法，終於病倒。蔣嬌乘機軟禁金仔，霸佔財務公司，讓行健、Joey加入公司，俊軒當眾支持。耀宗、瑪莉闖入戴家見到金仔，金仔向瑪莉求救。瑪莉、宇森搬進戴家，宇森與金仔暗中商量反擊大計。行健讓蔣嬌參加財務形象大使選舉，宇森、瑪莉出現，指金仔已讓宇森加入公司，並參加選舉。選舉宴會中，宇森安排懷疑被騙的客戶莊太向行健質問，但行健約了莊生前來，莊太只好啞忍。蔣嬌對行健不滿，二人關係出現暗湧。

programme.title: Kiki & Nuna 知識寶庫粵普
programme.desc: 在小鎮上生活著六個小朋友，在他們的日常生活中，會遇到形形色色的問題，有朋友之間的情感問題，有生活中的安全問題，有待人處事的行為規範，美妙世界的科學原理

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「廠長話」遊戲，曲奇隊與薯片隊各有一名隊員早早出局，兩隊剩下的代表都展示出色的聆聽能力與反應，實力不相上下。最終「廠長」蚌蚌公主只能以執行指令稍慢為準，判定一名小兵落敗，卻是雖敗猶榮。在神奇地壺任務中，兩隊均於第一次出手就成功「拿下」食材。然而於「收集」剩下的指定食材時，兩隊都遇上困難……「溶化之橋」關卡，所有小兵都於第二輪運送時挑戰更高難度，但有人順利突破，有人則失敗，成為決定這關勝負的關鍵。

programme.title: 天才高球少女粵日
programme.desc: 檜未能坦承過錯，但依然被罰一桿，稍覺釋懷。艾瑪左足踝接近極限，決定放手一搏，結果抓到老鷹，排名登上第一。蜻蛉不知不覺感受到壓力，被西明言指出後，經過一番掙扎，還是決定忠於自己。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 「小腦萎縮症」的醫學正式名稱為「脊髓小腦退化性動作協調障礙」，是一種罕見的神經系統退化性疾病。該病特徵是小腦及脊髓逐漸病雙，導致患者出現走路不穩、口齒不清、吞嚥困難與肌肉不協調等症狀。目前該病尚無法治癒，僅能透過復健與症狀治療延緩退化。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛． 回家之開心速遞#2825粵 及 保誠精選「寵愛寶」呈獻：社畜求生101粵
programme.desc: 尋寶圖急於籌備感謝祭，卻人手不足，力蓮安排Gen Z實習生Ivy加入。Ivy自有一套工作態度，若水察覺不妥，大感不滿。感謝祭的期限突然大幅提前，Ivy拒絕週末趕工，Sam亦設法要求放假，甚至連Elaine亦受二人「感染」……栢菲、若水縱合力趕工，計劃書仍難以完成，Ivy以非常手段勉強「埋尾」。力蓮卻不滿意，更不體諒栢菲、若水的辛勞。面對力蓮的不合理要求，栢菲、若水最終受Ivy影響，忍無可忍……

programme.title: 鼎植口腔呈獻：香港探秘地圖#17粵PG
programme.desc: 秀儀再找巫姑欲查出噩夢真相，在巫姑的刺激下終恢復兒時記憶，秀儀崩潰……金夫人受俊熙勸說，找一臣詢問金年的下落，一臣提出可以在金年失蹤前最後所見之人身上，搜集其氣息……一臣提議拍片將龍貴的惡行公告天下，並播出預告片。此事引起龍貴注意，並主動約見一臣，用錢買起影片。畢萍得知一臣被龍貴收買之事，直覺一臣並非單純貪錢，而是另有目的。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：成何體統#22粵普PG
programme.desc: 阿白把夏侯澹的密旨交給晚音，內容包括讓太子繼位和讓晚音攝政；晚音拒絕放棄營救夏侯澹，更親自率軍行動…城中傳來皇上賓天的消息，晚音不信，並認為反而說明夏侯澹不在端王手上。晚音去找阿白，懷疑室內有人匿藏…

programme.title: K Cash找數王呈獻：夫妻肺片粵
programme.desc: 再見亦是朋友？周吉佩自揭前度曾來電解釋十多年前分手原因，並做回朋友。支嚳儀主張徹底斷聯，莊思敏則認為可保留有底線的聯繫。至於如何處理舊愛所贈之物，有人笑稱視乎價值？何依婷曾在家中尋獲丈夫與前度的合照，當然無得留低！這次「恩愛實測」談論另一半最愛自己的優點，譚輝智竟自覺是外表，監場的太太掩面擰頭？吉吉視老婆為大佬，連線求證時妻子果然霸氣盡露！外表剛烈的思敏其實好可愛？支支致電兒子代答，卻換來重擊……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
無名天使3D#15粵PG
programme.desc: 樂琦約會堅強，堅強興奮過度飲醉酒，大出洋相。樂琦到泊車檔找堅強，樂琦更當眾親吻他，令他喜出望外。天華帶麗花去探望其褓母六姐，天華對六姐關懷備至，麗花知他是一外冷內熱的人，好感大增。拉美耶出席國際龍舟邀請賽當嘉賓，刺客以遠距離狙擊拉美耶，幸麗花和天華警覺性高，及時送走他。拉美耶嘉許反恐組，天華約會麗花，二人成好友。堅強與樂琦感情大進，堅強告訴麗花有新女友，麗花愕然。堅強春風滿面，麗花黯然神傷，對他的態度大變，令堅強莫名其妙。樂琦介紹新男友給麗花認識，麗花驚訝他竟是堅強。

programme.title: 我係小廚神3粵
programme.desc: 22位小廚神入圍者進入初賽，首先接受試食或試飲考驗，亦要在45分鐘內煮出自選菜式展廚藝。參賽小朋友的菜式各有特色，有些創意十足，有些藝術感甚重，亦有以傳統菜式出戰。有小朋友在最後5分鐘倒掉心血結晶，他受了甚麼刺激？亦有小朋友事事碰釘，未能做出預期作品。無論如何，完成品都要讓專業評判及星級評判試食，陳凱琳、黃心穎、杜如風、陳敏之有何評價？三位專業評判公布8強小廚神名單之餘，不忘給予他們評語及鼓勵。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 味之道
programme.desc: 【《無雙樓》掌廚四大弟子能否化解多年恩怨？】講述廚神秦奮幼年逃避戰亂來到新加坡，艱苦奮鬥後繼承家族餐館「無雙樓」。他收下四名徒弟南花、西紅、東白和北發，並傳授他們各自的獨門廚藝。南花因意外昏迷，餐飲集團「花花食界」由其妻子陳惠瑛掌管，二兒子若風最終成為總裁。為了延續父輩的夢想，若風決心重啟《無雙宴》，但四位師叔的恩怨讓合作變得困難重重。經過不斷的努力與真誠溝通，他逐漸打破了彼此的隔閡，重新喚醒了他們對秦奮的尊敬和對廚藝的熱情。

programme.title: 幽靈醫生
programme.desc: 【傲慢神醫Rain變幽靈，借用死對頭身體熱血救援】擁有神之手的傲慢天才醫生車英民，與含著金湯匙出生卻毫無使命感的臭手住院醫生高勝卓，原本是背景與實力天差地遠的死對頭。然而，一場突如其來的意外，讓英民變成了徘徊醫院的「幽靈」，更不得不附身在他最看不起的勝卓身上！當冷血名醫的靈魂進入笨拙富三代的身體，這對「二合一」的歡喜冤家被迫展開奇妙的共生生活。他們將如何在生死邊緣聯手拯救病患，並在無法離開醫院的命運中，重新領悟醫生的真諦？一場笑中帶淚的奇幻醫療冒險就此展開。

programme.title: 你的世界我們懂
programme.desc: 【2023紅星大獎獲《最佳電視劇》自閉症家庭的家人間扶持/溫馨勵志小品】鄭堅強和李家雲育有三名子女，長女天希，次子天偉，老么天才，一家人和樂融融。雖然天才被確診為自閉症，智能障礙者，家雲工作家庭兩頭忙，但仍努力當個好媽媽。天希跟天偉雖然各有自己的課業與生活，但也從小將照顧弟弟當成自身責任，全家互相扶持。直到有天，媽媽忍著來自公司的壓力，又被太過固執，一再失控的天才給弄得狼狽不堪，當場崩潰，家人們突然發現，沒辦法無時無刻陪在天才左右，天才必須學會獨立與工作，在不斷磨合碰撞下，這家人終於活出喜樂的一片天~

programme.title: 白夜童話
programme.desc: 【《紳士與小姐》朴荷娜演技狂飆復仇拋夫棄子生母】從小遭母親拋棄，加上父親早逝，白夜與哥哥相依為命，性格堅強好勝的她總對哥哥百般依賴，也因嫉妒哥哥與大嫂的好感情，生活中常常刁難懷孕的大嫂，搞得哥哥十分頭疼。某天哥哥與生母連絡上，面對母親拒絕相認，哥哥內心大受打擊，一晃神就因交通意外不幸離世，得知此事的白夜便將所有憤怒轉向母親，展開一系列的報復計畫。

programme.title: 不屈的兒媳
programme.desc: 【三百年宗族危機寡媳愛上財團之子】擁有三百年歷史的宗族大家庭「滿月堂」，卻深陷男人短命、香火將斷的宿命。長孫媳吳英心與丈夫結婚十年始終未能生育，卻在丈夫驟逝後被迫守寡；另一孫媳慧媛則遭丈夫拋棄。家族愁雲慘霧之際，愛情卻悄然來臨，兩位孫媳分別愛上財團之子，就連守節多年的婆婆也動了凡心。當傳統與情感正面衝突，滿月堂的女人們，究竟該守著祖訓終老，還是勇敢追求屬於自己的幸福？

programme.title: You Cant Win Em All
programme.desc: As the Ottoman Empire collapses throughout Turkey in 1922, a number of adventurers from all over the world sign on to protect the locals from thieves and marauders--for a hefty price. Two such mercenaries are Adam and Josh, who are hired by provincial Turkish governor Osman. Adam and Josh are expected to protect their boss' gold shipment, and to provide safe conduct for Osman Bey's three daughters. Along the way, our 'heroes' decide to forget their mission and abscond with the gold, but their plans are foiled by their own inherent ineptitude--and by the bothersome interference of duplicitous Colonel Elci.

programme.title: Hondo
programme.desc: Hondo is told to help make peace with Indian Chief Vittoro, whose daughter--Hondo's wife--had been killed by the Cavalry. Once the peace pipe is smoked, Hondo must deal with a renegade Native American who threatens the peace by randomly attacking settlers.

programme.title: Twin Dragons
programme.desc: Jackie Chan plays a dual role as twins separated at birth who grow up and cross paths. Two brothers, one becomes a famous conductor and pianist in New York, another becomes a racecar driver and bodyguard in Hong Kong. When the conductor travels to Hong Kong to give a concert, the twins get caught up in each other's business, about which they are anything but experts.

programme.title: Mill Of The Stone Women

programme.title: Red Sun
programme.desc: In 1870, a gang robs a train and steals a ceremonial Japanese sword meant as a gift for the U.S. President, prompting a manhunt to retrieve it.

programme.title: Cyclone
programme.desc: After a surprise cyclone hits the area, tourists become stranded on a boat in the sea, and they have to do anything in order to survive. To make matters even worse, they're joined by the survivors of a plane crash and a sinking boat.

programme.title: Casper the Friendly Ghost - Casper the Friendly Ghost Ep12 - EP112
programme.desc: Depressed by the antics of the other ghosts, Casper leaves home to make friends. After unintentionally scaring several potential pals, Casper befriends two young children. However, Casper scares away a banker who is coming to foreclose on the woman's house, and this wins her heart for Casper.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Gratefulness - EP107
programme.desc: In this episode, Nova will invite the children to a new expedition to the world of values. Curious will teach us about gifts such as love and friendship which are invisible but very valuable and we should be grateful to have them.

programme.title: Kids' Planet - Confidence, Honesty, and Integrity - EP118
programme.desc: In this episode, we will discover the values of confidence, honesty and integrity. We will learn that we build trust by fulfilling the promises we make to others. Rookie catches his new friend , and together they set up an amazing building.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Submarino
programme.desc: Accidentalmente, Chip y sus amigos caen a un lago donde son recogidos por la nave espacial de un átomo de sodio, que los lleva a Sodia, una ciudad submarina. Allí, los átomos de sodio y cloro viven un largo conflicto. El cloro quiere unirse al sodio para formar moléculas de cloruro de sodio, mientras que los átomos de sodio prefieren permanecer juntos. La patrulla de antimateria entra en contacto con el cloro y les propone proporcionarles rifles para dominar al sodio y así obligarlos a molecularizarse, pero Chip se burla de la antimateria y logra que el cloro y el sodio dejen de ser enemigos, restableciendo la paz en el mundo submarino.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La tormenta
programme.desc: Dentro de un viejo molino de viento, en medio de una fuerte tormenta, Chip y sus amigos esperan que pase y continúan su camino. Afuera, bajo el viento tempestuoso, la patrulla de antimateria le comunica al Dr. No que ya han encontrado al niño. El malvado científico confía en que esta vez no fallarán. Pero cuando el viento amaina, Chip idea una estrategia y deja a la antimateria encerrada en el molino, mientras él y los átomos siguen adelante.

programme.desc: There's a blackout in Car City! Troy selects the most ingenious truck to reconnect the cables: Chuck the Cherry Picker!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - Carl the Super Truck helps Frank the Firetruck
programme.desc: A lost container sends Troy into investigation mode. Who and where did it come from? He's very helpful and can transform!

programme.title: Troy the Train - Troy the Train - The Babies' trip to the Moon
programme.desc: The Babies are fascinated by the moon! Troy selects the most cosmic truck to help them get there: Rocky the Rocket!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - QUACK-QUACK - SUPERJUMP! ROOKIE AND THE FROG
programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Bluebird

programme.title: Falling Into Place

programme.title: Out Of The Blue

programme.title: Just Like A Woman

programme.title: Lightning-Struck

programme.title: Raahein

Sampling $2000 gold leaf pizza - the most expensive in the world - the pair put in a shift at the 2-Michelin starred restaurant The Modern, and try $3,000 jacket potatoes at the Mark, and AJ's favourite pizza place. They end their time in the Big Apple by serving up food for the suits on Wall Street from a pizza van.

programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Greek Job S01 - EP3
programme.desc: Inspired by Gerald Durrell's love of wildlife, Amanda and Alan design their first ever children's bedroom and visit Gerald's widow Lee for inspiration.

programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Greek Job S01 - EP4
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan show some love to the heart of the home, the kitchen. But with ivy growing out of the windows and a roof on the verge of collapse, it's not an easy ride.

programme.title: The Great South African Bake Off S04 - Finale
programme.desc: The top three bakers battle it out to be crowned South Africa's Best Amateur Baker. For their last challenge of the season they have 5 hours to create a large sculpture - the final chance to impress.

programme.title: Amazing Hotels: Life Beyond the Lobby S04 - Nimb Hotel, Copenhagen
programme.desc: Monica and Giles travel to Copenhagen to work at Nimb Hotel in the historic Tivoli Gardens. Giles learns to be the brake man on one of the world's oldest wooden rollercoasters, while Monica changes lightbulbs on the ornate Moroccan inspired facade and dives to clean an vast tropical aquarium. Giles learns how to get a table at one of the city's most avant-garde restaurants, and Monica dresses in horror makeup to give Giles the pleasure of being terrified.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Food Stories S01 - West Country
programme.desc: In the West Country, Rick meets an organic food pioneer, Britain's most famous female cheese maker, and chef Mark Hix, the master of simple British food. Then, he cooks his own vegetarian dishes.

programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Italian Job S02 - EP3
programme.desc: Amanda and Alan turn their attention to the great outdoors as they aim to tackle the garden. programme.title: Amanda and Alan's Italian Job S02 - EP4
programme.desc: Alan takes charge of tackling the first bedroom, and he doesn't hold back with his design. Inspired by the romance and history of his favourite city Florence, he's determined to have a mural, but Amanda fears his creative juices could turn into a flood. programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Wimbledon, England
programme.desc: The Go Jetters visit Wimbledon in England.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Cave of Crystals, Mexico
programme.desc: While in Mexico Glitch takes a short cut through the Cave of Crystals, a very hot hidden space that contains some of the biggest crystals in the world! The clumsy Grandmaster falls off one of the crystals and into a deep ravine. Glitch and the Grimbots are in trouble, can the Go Jetters rescue them with the help of their brand new GO Suits before things get too hot to handle!?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Be Brave Bryan
programme.desc: Bryan gets spooked and thinks there's a lake monster lurking in the mists. It'll be Mojo and Bo who have to find the monster... or show Bryan that there's no monster at all!

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Cherry Picker!
programme.desc: The town's ferris wheel is stuck, so Mojo and Bo have to get it moving. But they do their job too well, because the wheel rolls away, forcing Mojo and Bo to chase it down.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Aargh! Jelly!
programme.desc: Broccoli shows Supertato her latest art exhibition of jelly sculptures, but jelly is Supertato's secret fear. When Evil Pea finds out, she comes up with an evil idea to beat him.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Veggie Magic
programme.desc: When Evil Pea poses as a magician so that she can use tricks to make the Tato Team 'disappear', Supertato and Carrot create their own magical plan to rescue them.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Tato Tower Takeover
programme.desc: Evil Pea and the Mini Peas take over the Tato Tower HQ and lock Supertato out.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Teamwork Badge
programme.desc: A box full of bits and pieces is delivered to the Clubhouse and the Squirrels are excited. Duggee and the Squirrels are going to have to work hard to put it all together. Time for a bit of teamwork.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Dancing Bug Badge
programme.desc: When a dancing bug lands on Duggee's head, he can't stop dancing. The Squirrels see that it's a tiny hillbilly bug with a fiddle. And what's more, he's got a band with him - the Hillbilly Bug Band.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Train Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is playing with his train set. Choo-choo! It's amazing! The squirrels are curious and want to know all about it. Duggee explains that it is a toy but it works exactly like a real train. Hennie arrives and she has a train too. The squirrels ask if they can play with it. You can't play with it; you can play IN it says Hennie.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Pizza Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels help Duggee try out his new outdoor pizza oven. Duggee makes the bases, then the Squirrels each put on all the toppings they like best. Some of their combinations are ... interesting!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Say Cheese
programme.desc: The Squirrels learn about butterflies and tortoises.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Eugene's Animal Chorus
programme.desc: Eugene gives an unexpected performance with help from some talented animals! Mooo!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Copy The King
programme.desc: The Squirrels play Copy the King!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Animals
programme.desc: The Squirrel club play games involving animals. The chickens do some rhythmic office work.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mysterious Milkshake
programme.desc: More fun with Duggee, biscuits, eggs, toys and of course milkshakes.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Dump
programme.desc: On a trip to the Dump, Dad claims he's the best at everything. But Bluey discovers that Dad's throwing out her old drawing and questions if he really is the best Dad in the world.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Zoo
programme.desc: Bluey's backyard zoo is home to wonderful animals, especially the big blue Daddy gorilla. But when he grabs visitor Bingo and escapes, Zookeeper Bluey must recapture the wild beast.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Backpackers
programme.desc: Mum and Dad are going on an adventure wearing the kids as their cheeky backpacks! Seeing the sights and buying street food, backpacking is a blast - until they lose their passports.

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Adventure
programme.desc: Princesses, horses and magic wands. Bluey and Chloe can play any role they want, when they embark on an adventure to save their playground kingdom from the Greedy Queen.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Grizzly Bears
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head off on a global adventure to Sierra Nevada in California, searching for a mother grizzly bear and her cubs.

programme.title: Andy's Global Adventures S01 - Chimpanzees
programme.desc: Andy, Jen and Scout head to the forests of the Ivory coast in West Africa on a global adventure to find out how chimpanzees break open African walnuts.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Close the Gate
programme.desc: The Teletubbies accidentally leave the Tiddlytubbies' gate open and some of them escape into Home Dome. The Teletubbies must find them all and then close the gate.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S05 - Sun
programme.desc: There is a yellow sun, a shining sun, a setting sun, a warm sun and a sporty sun. We see Dee snowboard in the snow sun and watch her and a friend help things grow in the sun.

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S03 - Rusty Robot
programme.desc: When Stan Tall starts to develop rust, it's up to Messy to help him get to Maker Mechanic. Will they make it in time?

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Cable Car Crisis
programme.desc: Preston needs rescuing from a stuck cable car. But when the car suddenly starts moving again, Mojo has to ride the cable to chase it down and save poor Preston.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Tradies
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo hide under the house and spy on two mysterious tradies working in the backyard, wondering what they're up to.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Onesies
programme.desc: When mum's sister Brandy comes over for a visit, she brings the kids onesies as a present, which has an unexpected effect on Bingo.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered what goes on at the Squirrel Club when the sun goes down?

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - El Gran Final
programme.desc: Join the chickens in space for the big finale of Agony and Eggstacy! Mucho Suspense!

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Statue of Liberty, USA
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch makes the Statue of Liberty fall right into the path of a passing ferry. It's up to the Go Jetters to save the day!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - The Beach
programme.desc: As Mum goes for a walk along the beach, Bluey runs to catch up with her. Along the way, she has a series of encounters that both excite and test her in her first solo adventure.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Library
programme.desc: When Muffin is told that she is special by her Dad, she interprets it as an excuse to do anything she wants, which means playing Bluey and Bingo's game of Library her way.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Andy's Safari Adventures S01 - Andy and the Treeshrew
programme.desc: When Mr Hammond inadvertently eats all the mangosteen fruit that was meant for the new treeshrews, it's up to Andy to find some more. Jetting off in his safari-mobile, Andy heads to the rainforests of Borneo in search of a treeshrew and its favourite food, mangosteens. Along the way, Andy comes face to face with a tree snake and some hungry wild pigs.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Star
programme.desc: Bella and Lift are visited by a shining star and set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. The first stop is Sketch in Boxtropolis - what will she be making today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S03 - The Tooth Brushing Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels meet a lion with unfortunate breath and teach him a special song to help him learn how to brush his teeth.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Glasses Badge
programme.desc: When Mole was young he wanted to be a Stunt Mole! Can Duggee and the squirrels help make his dreams come true? The first problem to fix is Mole's eyesight. Happy thinks he needs glasses, but Mole explains he can't wear them for stunts as they keep falling off his nose. Luckily Duggee has his Glasses Badge, so he has an idea how they can fix them.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Fashion Badge
programme.desc: Duggee's uniform is a bit old and needs to be updated. Duggee can make his own clothes!! Over the years Duggee has made lots of clothes. The Squirrels are very impressed and help to make some new clothes and present them at their fashion show. But will their Winter, Fall, Spring, Summer Duggee Collection! be a success?

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Monkey Bay, Thailand
programme.desc: Glitch's plans to open a hotel on an unspoilt beach in Thailand go horribly wrong when a group of macaque monkeys steal his Grim-o-freeze gun.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Himalayan Heroes, Nepal
programme.desc: Hoping to follow in his great-aunt's footsteps, Glitch enlists the help of a sceptical Foz and a friendly yak in order to find a yeti in the Himalayas.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Chucklesome Trucks
programme.desc: When Rebecca works with the Troublesome Trucks, everyone expects the worst, but she defies everyone's expectations and has a very amusing day.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Mountain Mints
programme.desc: Scarf Lady takes Sarah and Duck on trip up the mountains. At the top of a mountain they find Poetry Pete reading a poem. When the day is nearly over, Scarf Lady suggests a fast way down the mountain.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S03 - Fluff Bread
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck help the baker bake Shoku-pan, a light and fluffy type of Japanese bread.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Farm
programme.desc: Amare asks Stanley to help her on the farm. Stanley asks Little Woo, Fred and Fifi to join him in sowing seeds, watering plants and picking apples, all whilst having fun.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Shop
programme.desc: Stanley covers Jose at the shop and ends up making too much popcorn. So as not to waste it all, Stanley and his friends put on a film night to screen Little Woo's film.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Don't like Sleeping and I'm Never Tired!
programme.desc: The talking animals chat about bedtime.

programme.desc: JoJo and Gran Gran are getting ready for a Halloween party, but when JoJo accidentally squashes their spooky pumpkin lantern, they need a replacement! Luckily Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Musical Statues

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Stories

programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo teach Unicorse good manners so he can ask Mum on a date, but things go awry when Unicorse eats a tick.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: The Condemned
programme.desc: Feng, a homeless man, is wrongly accused of robbery and subsequently arrested and imprisoned. The actual bandit bribes fellow inmate Yang, a pickpocket, to kill Feng. Aware of Feng's innocence, Yang resolves to help him escape from prison. However, their escape attempt goes awry, and both find themselves facing the grim reality of death row.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Killer Has No Return
programme.desc: Professional killer Lui goes to Malaysia after completing his mission of killing the big boss of a Hong Kong gang. His next target is a groom who is throwing his wedding banquet at a hotel in Chinatown. Just when Lui takes aim at his target, another victim instead of the groom is shot, and he becomes a scapegoat in this mystery assassination.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Swordswomen Three
programme.desc: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon could be called "Swordswomen Two." Three decades earlier, Shen Yi, Essie Lin Chia, and Pan Ying-tzu took on Shaw's first international superstar, Lo Lieh for the Han Family Sword - making this a four-star treat for action fans.

programme.title: Challenge of the Gamesters
programme.desc: A master gambler and his partner are recruited to investigate a Shanghai tycoon suspected of using his casino as a front for espionage. As they enter the high-stakes gambling world, they must outwit a dangerous opponent in a deadly game of skill and deception.

programme.title: Rose, Be My Love
programme.desc: Not a love triangle but a love 'rectangle', Rose, Be My Love is a romantic drama set on the eve of World War II that represents the high standards achieved by Shaw Brothers in both aspects of star power and technical polish.

programme.title: Mr Funny - bone
programme.desc: Join Mr Funny bone in a series of comic vignettes as he attempts to win the heart of a dashing lady. Along for the ride is his loyal sidekick Mr Big Potato, a stout fellow who is forever getting into silly mishaps. The pair gets involved in plenty of shenanigans and gags!

programme.title: The Tigress Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Sam is being hunted as he discovers that the mayor and the chief of medical bureau are colluding with a drug dealer. He is saved by a fishermen family and works in their friend's grocery but the grocery owner is killed when the enemies track Sam down. Sam escapes to Shaolin to learn the cudgel style of kung fu in order to avenge his friends.

programme.title: The Emperor and the Minister
programme.desc: The ingenious imperial scholar Liu Yung always embarrasses Emperor Chien Lung with his quick wit and gift of gab. The emperor purposely sets him up to solve the seemingly unsolvable. However, Liu Yung resolves it easily with wit and style and foils the emperor's plot once again.

programme.title: The Magnificent Swordsman
programme.desc: The Magnificent Swordsman centres on the hero who vows vengeance against evil bandits who killed his family when he was a child. The hero recruits several friends to help the peasants rid their village of marauding bandits, the leader of the band being the man who killed his family.

programme.title: My Name Ain't Suzie
programme.desc: Young Mei Li works as a bar girl in Wanchai to make a living. When she meets Jimmy in the bar, she thinks he is her true love and falls crazily in love with him. When Jimmy has to leave, Mei Li is devastated. It is not until she encounters the triad boss Ying that she finally found someone to count on.

programme.title: Executioners From Shaolin
programme.desc: The White-Browed Priest supports the brutal Qing government, burning down Shaolin Temple and hunting its disciples. Shaolin's Hung falls in love with Fang while escaping the hunt and the couple have a son before Hung is killed by the Priest. To avenge his father, Hung's son creates a new form of martial art combining his parents' kung fu styles.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Forever And Ever
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po plays a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter. After marrying, he soon discovers the reason for her hesitation. She is stricken with a contagious disease. But, with the power of true love, their romance prevails.

programme.title: Heroes Of Sung
programme.desc: Heroes Of Sung stars one of the original kung fu ladies of the silver screen, Shih Szu, who plays swordswoman Meng Hung. She must work with Fan Tien-Fu, played by Lo Lieh to find and protect the royal seals of the Sung Dynasty. Shih's magnificent performance earned her the female hero role in another hit Dracula And The 7 Golden Vampires.

programme.title: Rear Entrance
programme.desc: Mrs Xu is childless and watches a lonely little girl playing at the rear entrance from afar every day. She warmly nurtures the girl and even adopts her from her uncaring parent. The girl brings happiness to the Xu's until her long lost mother appears one day and to make her happy, Mrs Xu reluctantly lets the girl reunite with her mother.

programme.title: The Voyage of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung continues his incognito voyage to southern China. Accompanied by the minister and the imperial scholar, they have many amusing encounters in Yangzhou.

programme.title: Twin Blades Of Doom
programme.desc: A retired martial artist is forced to return with a vengeance after his family and friends are murdered by the evil Ghost Gang. He decides to challenge the gang's leader to a deadly duel so as to take revenge. Can he defeat the ruthless leader in the end?

programme.title: Crazy Shaolin Disciples
programme.desc: The story revolves around three lay disciples of the Shaolin Temple: Fang Shi Yu, Hong Xi Guan, and Hu Hui Qian. Monk Jie instructs them in martial arts, but their frequent competitions with fellow disciple Wu Qing spark rivalries. The once serene Shaolin Temple is plunged into chaos, yet even the abbot cannot help but be amused by their antics.

programme.title: Six Assassins
programme.desc: Lord Li Ming is a feudal tyrant who oppresses the people, and even the Emperor who is his brother, cannot stop his evil act. Righteous swordsman Mu poses as Li Ming's guard to plan for his assassination. He arrests six assassins who have tried to kill Li Ming, before making them his allies in a secret plot to kill him and end the tyranny.

programme.title: The Lady Assassin
programme.desc: Two feuding princes fight for the throne in the Qing Dynasty, causing many injuries and deaths to the commoners. Can the lady assassin who is drawn into this royal feud execute her assassination mission in time to help one of the princes secure the throne?

programme.title: The Black Tavern
programme.desc: This sword-filled thriller centres on The Black Tavern - an inn where the down and dirty meet to plot nefarious doings. A bunch of villains are lured to the inn by a rumour about a valuable treasure being hidden there. After all the backstabbing and killings, they realise that it is a trap created to wipe them out once and for all…

programme.title: Empress Wu
programme.desc: Wu Ze Tian is a beautiful and talented concubine of Emperor Tang at age 14. She becomes a nun after he died but has two sons with the new Emperor Tang Gao Zong. The Empress asks Wu to team up with her against Consort Xiao, but is set up and dethroned by Wu, who also kills her two sons. After the Emperor's death, Wu becomes the first woman Emperor.

programme.title: Dragon Swamp
programme.desc: Fan is cheated by her lover Tong to steal her master's Jade Dragon Sword. She is jailed in the Dragon Swamp as punishment and gave birth to a pair of twins - her daughter is raised by her master, while her son is taken by Tong. Twenty years later, the sword is stolen again and Fan's daughter goes seeking for it, meeting Fan's friend along the way.

programme.title: Let's Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fiancé so as to drive away two women whom he does not like…

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: The Comedy of Mismatches
programme.desc: Two pairs of lovers got mismatched accidentally. The man disguises as a woman for his sister's wedding ceremony, while his lover disguises as a man to marry another woman. After the marriage mismatches are revealed, the lovers and their families are taken to court, where Prefecture Chief Qiao manages to work out a happy ending.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Notorious Eight
programme.desc: The young Chen Chi-chin (Liu Yung) loses heavily to experienced gambler Hu Kuan-ten (Lo Lieh). His father loses at cards and dies of shock. Chen appeals to his uncle who summons seven fellow professional gamblers to carry out vengeance. Much more than a gambling film, this is a thrilling melting pot of martial arts stars, extortion, illicit love, poker-face vengeance, and all sorts of edge-of-your-seat gambling duels.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love (or lust) has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couple's brothel.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: After a royal coup, two princes are separated, one raised in Shaolin as Dao Xing, the other as Wu Zi Tai under a minister. Years later, they meet at Shaolin while seeking the Yi Jin Jing, unaware they are brothers, as hidden identities and destiny unfold amid rising conflict and danger.

programme.title: Na Cha And The Seven Devils
programme.desc: While stealing one magical peach from a mystic tree in Heaven, Little Na Cha accidentally drops seven others on Earth, which transformed seven different animals into seven devils. Na Cha must hunt the devils down in ten days or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven. Can Na Cha complete his mission?

programme.title: The Bully
programme.desc: For lovers of the Shaw's sumptuous production and martial arts expertise, this action adventure in the "Jackie Chan style" is a special treat. A persecuted waiter turns to a "drunken master" for help when a restaurant customer turns out to be a kung-fu harbinger of doom!

programme.title: The Shadow Boxer
programme.desc: Skilled shadow Tai Chi boxer Ku Ting hides his skills by working as a construction worker. However, when the thugs assaulted his girlfriend, Ku Ting has no choice but to use his kung fu to show his enemies what it takes to keep justice in line.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: Singer Qing Qing and architect Peng Nan are a devoted couple. Qing Qing sacrifices herself to help Peng Nan when his family is going through difficulties and is misunderstood by Peng Nan, leading to their break up. When Peng Nan learns the truth and decides to make up with Qing Qing, he finds out that she is suffering from a terminal illness.

programme.title: Roving Swordsman
programme.desc: An ambitious evil clan intends to rule the martial arts world. To achieve their goal, they must first steal a secret martial arts manuscript depicting how firearms can be produced. However, a supremely intelligent swordsman Shen Sheng Yi is protecting the manuscript and remains one step ahead of the evil clan.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Gambler's Delight
programme.desc: The Killer star Danny Lee plays the lead role of a guy who needs to become a hero. He lies, steals and cheats his way into operating a plush casino, but when he incurs the wrath of a female Japanese gang leader, all bets are off!

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Iron Bodyguard
programme.desc: Wang Wu, the head of a security firm Iron Bodyguard, meets a scholar who is a member of the Reformists, a group of scholars pressing for social reform in China at the end of the Qing dynasty. The Emperor actually supports such reforms but not the Empress Dowager. She orders the Reformists to be arrested and Wang Wu gets drawn into the politics.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: Continuing from the first movie, Tang Qi ends her career as a nightclub singer and starts searching battle-scarred China for her lover Chang, who is now entangled with Japanese invaders, communist insurgents, and a warlord's beautiful daughter.

programme.title: The Flying Dagger
programme.desc: The Yu family and the Green Dragon clan became enemies when the Yu daughter killed the clan head's son, who was a rapist and murderer. The Green Dragon leader wounds the head of the Yu family with his flying daggers, and a wandering swordsman saves the family using his own flying dagger skills. However, his allegiances and motives are unclear.

programme.title: The Delinquent
programme.desc: This is a coming-of-age tale depicting the lower class Hong Kong troubled youths in the 1960s and the societal issues that they face. Wang Chung is a hotheaded and rebellious teen who is tempted by the dark side, and have to unfortunately pay a huge price for it.
